DSA.Title: Sound Archive
DSA.Name: Display name
DSA.CategoryHint: Use a unique key such as voice.attack or weapon.fire. Letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens are allowed.
DSA.Label: Custom label (optional)
DSA.FolderHint: Folder contents are cached. Refresh Folder discovers changes. Hidden clips remain excluded on refresh.
DSA.HideClip: Hide clip from this folder (keep source asset)
DSA.Search: Search audio names, labels and paths…
DSA.ReadOnly: Read-only archive. Document ownership is required to make changes.
DSA.StartHint: Create a group, then link existing audio files or folders.
DSA.EmptyFolder: No audio files in this folder. Try Refresh Folder.
DSA.Footer: Changes save automatically · Preview plays only for you · Removing references keeps the original assets
DSA.ConfirmGroup: Remove “{name}” and all its references? The original audio assets will be kept.
DSA.UnexpectedError: The archive could not complete this operation.
DSA.InvalidPath: Choose a valid Foundry path or HTTP(S) asset URL.
DSA.NotAudio: Choose an audio file (OGG, MP3, WAV, WEBM, M4A, AAC, FLAC or OPUS).
DSA.InvalidDocument: Pass a saved Foundry Actor or Item document, including an embedded Item.
DSA.ReadDenied: You need Observer permission to read this archive.
DSA.EditDenied: You need document ownership and update permission to edit this archive. Locked compendiums cannot be edited.
DSA.UnsupportedSchema: The saved archive has an unsupported schema. Use the module version that created it; its data has not been overwritten.
DSA.GroupMissing: The audio group no longer exists. Reopen the archive and try again.
DSA.EntryMissing: The audio entry no longer exists.
DSA.EntryChanged: The folder changed while refreshing. Refresh again.
DSA.InvalidCategory: Use letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens for the category key.
DSA.DuplicateCategory: Another group already uses this category identifier.
DSA.PickerUnavailable: The file picker is unavailable. Check your Foundry/Forge connection and permissions.
DSA.ForgeUnavailable: The Forge Assets source is unavailable outside The Forge. Your cached clips are still available.
DSA.SourceUnavailable: The selected file source is not supported.
DSA.FolderUnavailable: Could not read the entire folder. Check access and the saved path. Existing cached clips have been kept.
DSA.ScanLimit: Scan limit exceeded (5,000 audio files or 100 User Data directories). Link a smaller folder.
DSA.PlaybackFailed: Cannot preview this audio. Check the file URL, browser codec support and asset permissions:
DSA.ActorDefaultsFailed: Default audio groups could not be saved for {count} Actor(s). Existing archives were kept. Check the console and try opening their archives as an owner.
DSA.ItemDefaultsFailed: Default weapon audio groups could not be saved for {count} Item(s). Existing archives were kept. Check the console and try opening their archives as an owner.
DSA.PrototypeMenuHint: Manage the world’s default group names and category keys. Save adds missing groups to Actors or Items without removing existing groups or sounds.
DSA.PrototypeHint: Save adds missing groups to world sheets and unlinked scene tokens. An existing category key or matching name is reused; its custom key, name, sounds and folders are kept. Editing or removing prototype rows never deletes or renames existing sheet groups. Changes here stay in this window until Save.
DSA.PrototypeKeyHint: Use a unique category key starting with
DSA.PrototypeRemove: Remove prototype row (keep existing sheet groups)
DSA.PrototypeEmpty: No prototype groups. Add Group to create one; existing sheet archives will be kept.
DSA.PrototypeSaving: Saving prototype and applying missing groups…
DSA.PrototypeSaved: Prototype saved. Missing groups applied; existing groups and sounds preserved.
DSA.PrototypePartial: Prototype saved. {failed} archive(s) could not be updated. Existing data was preserved; reopen them as an owner or reload as GM to retry.
DSA.PrototypeDelegated: Prototype saved. The active GM applies missing groups. Reload the world as GM if necessary.
DSA.PrototypeGMOnly: Only a GM can manage prototype groups.
DSA.PrototypeConflict: Another GM changed this prototype after you opened it. Your draft has not been saved. Reopen the menu and merge your changes.
DSA.UnsupportedPrototype: The prototype setting has an unsupported format. No archive was changed. Restore a valid prototype before retrying.
DSA.PrototypeNameInvalid: Every prototype row needs a display name of 1–200 characters.
DSA.PrototypeVoiceKeyInvalid: Voice keys must start with voice. and contain only letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens (maximum 100 characters).
DSA.PrototypeWeaponKeyInvalid: Weapon keys must start with weapon. and contain only letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens (maximum 100 characters).
DSA.PrototypeLegacyKey: voice.movement is reserved for older macros. Use voice.move or a different voice key.
DSA.PrototypeDuplicateName: Prototype group names must be unique (ignoring case and extra spaces).
